metadata.auditor_role: Independent Computer-Vision Evaluation Auditor and Reproducibility Engineer
metadata.evaluation_scope: JAAD (2010 frames, 9 sequences) & VIRAT fixture (67 frames, 1 sequence)
metadata.hardware_spec: Intel Core i3-1215U (6C/8T, 4 threads PyTorch CPU), 7.68 GB RAM, Windows 11

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: TP / (TP + FP) at conf >= 0.25, IoU >= 0.50 greedy multi-instance match
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: Measured on automotive dashcam video. Highly resistant to background false alarms under near/medium camera ranges.
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: YOLOv8n achieved 87.80% precision across 2,010 evaluated JAAD dashcam frames (853 false alarms), demonstrating strong background suppression.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: TP / (TP + FP) at conf >= 0.25, IoU >= 0.50 greedy multi-instance match
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: Zero-shot COCO checkpoint produces 10,410 false positives (5.18 FP/frame) due to high sensitivity to textured background and vegetation.
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: Off-the-shelf D-FINE-N recorded 41.71% precision on JAAD dashcam footage due to 10,410 false alarms (5.18 per frame), requiring domain adaptation before deployment.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: TP / (TP + FN) at conf >= 0.25, IoU >= 0.50 greedy multi-instance match
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: Lower overall recall than D-FINE-N, primarily missing heavily occluded or small pedestrians (<32px height).
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: YOLOv8n detected 46.64% of pedestrians overall (6,138/13,161 ground-truth boxes) on JAAD dashcam video.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: TP / (TP + FN) at conf >= 0.25, IoU >= 0.50 greedy multi-instance match
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: Superior overall sensitivity, capturing +9.96% more pedestrian instances (7,449/13,161), statistically significant (p=0.0039).
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: D-FINE-N demonstrated superior sensitivity on JAAD dashcam footage, capturing 56.60% of pedestrian instances (7,449/13,161).

authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: Balances precision and recall effectively for real-world alerts.
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: YOLOv8n achieved an F1-score of 60.92% on JAAD dashcam sequences.

authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: F1 penalized by high false-positive volume.
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: D-FINE-N achieved an F1-score of 48.03% on JAAD dashcam sequences.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: Global COCO 101-point interpolated AP on raw ranked detections at IoU=0.50
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: Difference vs D-FINE-N (53.02%) is statistically non-significant (p=0.1641).
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: YOLOv8n scored 54.47% AP@0.50 on JAAD dashcam sequences under standard COCO evaluation protocol.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: Global COCO 101-point interpolated AP on raw ranked detections at IoU=0.50
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: D-FINE-N scored 53.02% AP@0.50 on JAAD dashcam sequences under standard COCO evaluation protocol.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: Greedy multi-instance matching against all frame GT instances; Child TP=949 / 1936
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: Evaluated across 15 active child tracks in JAAD dashcam sequences (1,936 boxes). Does not constitute a gated residential community population benchmark.
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: On 1,936 evaluated JAAD child pedestrian instances, YOLOv8n detected 49.02% (949/1,936) of child boxes.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: Greedy multi-instance matching against all frame GT instances; Child TP=1053 / 1936
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: Evaluated across 15 active child tracks in JAAD dashcam sequences (1,936 boxes). Does not constitute a gated residential community population benchmark.
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: On 1,936 evaluated JAAD child pedestrian instances, D-FINE-N detected 54.39% (1,053/1,936) of child boxes.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: TP matching for GT instances with area < 32^2 px (15/459)
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: Identifies severe drop in sensitivity for distant pedestrians in dashcam footage.
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: YOLOv8n captured 3.27% (15/459) of small distant pedestrians (<32px height) on JAAD dashcam sequences.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: TP matching for GT instances with area < 32^2 px (106/459)
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: Demonstrates 7.07x higher sensitivity on small distant pedestrians compared to YOLOv8n, though accompanied by higher background false alarms.
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: D-FINE-N captured 23.09% (106/459) of small distant pedestrians (<32px height) on JAAD dashcam sequences, showing stronger feature preservation.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: Arithmetic mean of inference-only time.perf_counter() on Intel Core i3-1215U (4 threads PyTorch CPU)
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: Inference only, excludes frame decode and post-processing. Measured on edge Intel i3 CPU.
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: YOLOv8n achieved an average CPU inference latency of 106.43 ms (9.40 FPS) on an Intel Core i3-1215U edge processor.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: Arithmetic mean of inference-only time.perf_counter() on Intel Core i3-1215U (4 threads PyTorch CPU)
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: 2.72x slower than YOLOv8n, exceeding single-stream budget for real-time video without aggressive keyframe sampling.
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: D-FINE-N averaged 289.42 ms (3.46 FPS) per frame on CPU inference on an Intel Core i3-1215U processor.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: TP / (TP + FP) across 67 frames, 2 adult pedestrian tracks
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: Preliminary sanity check on a small 67-frame fixture. Contains zero child pedestrians and cannot validate residential community deployment.
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: In preliminary tests on a 67-frame elevated surveillance sample (VIRAT), YOLOv8n recorded 0 false alarms across 134 pedestrian instances.

authoritative_metrics.calculation_method: TP / (TP + FP) across 67 frames, 2 adult pedestrian tracks
authoritative_metrics.qualification_limitation: All 40 false positives are low-overlap (IoU ~0.31) partial body detections of the 2 pedestrians; lamp post hallucination claim retracted.
authoritative_metrics.exact_permitted_website_wording: In preliminary tests on a 67-frame elevated surveillance sample (VIRAT), D-FINE-N recorded 45.95% precision due to bounding-box fragmentation around the pedestrians.

not_displayable_metrics.reason: Methodological artifact resulting from applying an operational confidence threshold prior to precision-recall curve integration. Violates standard COCO benchmark protocol.
Artifact of ignoring adult ground-truth boxes during greedy matching, allowing detector boxes targeting adults to erroneously match adjacent children.

not_displayable_metrics.metric_name: VIRAT Fixed Lamp Post / Lane Marker Hallucinations
not_displayable_metrics.reason: Retracted. Forensic visual and coordinate inspection confirmed all 40 D-FINE-N false alarms were truncated lower-body pedestrian detections, not static pole hallucinations.
SafeKid AI has not yet collected or evaluated multi-camera residential community footage. JAAD is forward-facing dashcam video and VIRAT is a 67-frame sample fixture.
